summary: Read a list of distinct integers arranged from small to large, then read one number to place. When that number already occurs, write the index of its current slot. When it does not occur, write the index it should take so that inserting it there keeps the list increasing. Indexes begin at 0. Placing it before every current value yields 0. Placing it after every current value yields the present length.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is a count, that many integers, and one target integer.
